verses.text: For the music director. On an instrument from Gath. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God, our strength! Shout with joy to the God of Jacob!
Start the music! Play the tambourine and the sweet lyre and harp.
Blow the ram's horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on our festival day.
This is a law for Israel, a rule from the God of Jacob.
He made it a law for the people of Joseph when he went out against the land of Egypt. I heard a voice I did not know say:
"I took the load off their shoulders. Their hands were set free from carrying baskets.
You called out in your trouble, and I rescued you. I answered you from the thundercloud. I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
Listen, my people, and I will warn you. Israel, if only you would listen to me!
You must not have any foreign god among you. You must not bow down to any strange god.
I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
But my people would not listen to me. Israel did not want me.
So I let them follow their own stubborn hearts and live by their own plans.
If only my people would listen to me! If only Israel would follow my ways!
I would quickly defeat their enemies and turn my hand against those who attack them.
Those who hate the LORD would bow down to him in fear, and their punishment would last forever.
But I would feed you with the finest wheat. I would satisfy you with honey from the rock."
